quarterly_data.quarter: TDK press release: TDK and TAIYO YUDEN enter into a memorandum of (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Taiyo Yuden: TDK signed a memorandum of understanding to begin discussions on a comprehensive business alliance centred on joint development of advanced electronic components including cutting-edge MLCCs and inductors, also encompassing cooperation in manufacturing and procurement; the companies will also consider a future capital alliance and jointly preparing a stable-supply plan for METI approval under Japan's Economic Security Promotion Act (MLCCs are designated Specified Critical Products). Rationale stated: rapidly rising demand for high-capacitance, highly reliable MLCCs and inductors from AI data centers, AI servers and physical AI. Specific areas and roles are still to be discussed; no existing capital, personnel or business relationship.
